cca.summary: Record of every Admit verdict with attractors of the accepted shapes. Admit reads it only as a route hint and never as a permission.
use_when: an audit needs the record of every judged proposal
intent records and graph runs need a search over past shapes
avoid_when: pure stateless agents with no memory needs
